title: Column
description: Column: Represents the definition of a column in a SQLite table including type, constraints, and metadata.

DataType.description: The SQLite data type for this column. SqliteDataType: Defines SQLite data types and storage classes for column definitions and type mapping.

NetTypeName.description: The original .NET property type name for type conversion during data retrieval.

AllowNull.description: Whether this column can contain null values.

IsPrimaryKey.description: Whether this column is a primary key.

IsAutoIncrement.description: Whether this column auto-increments for integer primary keys.

IsUnique.description: Whether this column has a unique constraint.

DefaultValue.description: The default value for this column as a string. null if no default.

MaxLength.description: The maximum length for text columns. Zero means no limit.

Position.description: The position of this column in the table (0-based).

AdditionalConstraints.description: Additional column attributes or constraints as SQL text.

_bhomVersion.description: Optional version of BHoM used as part of automatic versioning and schema upgrades.
